prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1231; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear passenger quarter panel and rear door on the driver's side show scraping, a crease along the lower edge, and a cracked taillight lens, all consistent with a sideways contact at low speed while the other vehicle moved into the adjacent lane. The damage pattern lines up with the account given of the incident. The repair plan calls for replacing the taillight assembly, straightening and refinishing the rear door, and blending the quarter panel into the adjacent paint. The labor hours requested fit the work described. Parts and paint charges on the invoices appear once each, with no duplicated line items. Nothing in the vehicle's history or the shop's records suggests earlier damage to these areas.
